name: implement-vscode
description: Editor support for implement. Completes Div( to Div({}, ), closes nested calls with a comma, and writes out If and ForEach.
author: Aidan Bleser

enumDescriptions: Offer the snippet as a preselected suggestion; Tab accepts it.
Experimental. Rewrite as you type the paren, with no keypress.
Land in the children position: Div({}, |).
Land inside the props braces: Div({|}, ).
implement.snippets.cursor.description: Where the cursor lands after a props snippet is inserted.

implement.snippets.trailingComma.description: Close a call nested in another call or an array with a comma. Uses a bracket scan rather than a parser, so brackets inside a regex literal can fool it.

implement.snippets.requireImport.description: Only match names already imported in this file. When false, the HTML element names also match before the import exists, unless the name is declared in this file.

implement.snippets.resolveLocalComponent.description: Read the declaration of components imported from this project, through relative paths and tsconfig path aliases, to find out whether they take props. Never reads node_modules.

implement.snippets.constructs.description: Offer If and ForEach as whole shapes while typing the name, adding the import when it is missing.

implement.snippets.extraSources.markdownDescription: Module specifiers whose capitalized exports follow a component convention, for barrels that `resolveLocalComponents` cannot see through. `{ "@/lib/ui": "propsChildren" }`. Matched exactly or by path suffix.
